newsitem.title: ROMANIA: BOXING-ROMANIA COACH SACKED IN EXTORTION PROBE.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-ROMANIA COACH SACKED IN EXTORTION PROBE.

text.p: Romania's Boxing Federation sacked the national coach on Tuesday during an investigation into allegations he had extorted money from boxers who won tournaments or were seeking places on the team.

"In view of media reports of irregularities in coach Relu Auras's activities...the federation has decided to dismiss him," said a statement signed by federation President Ion Serban and reported by the official Rompres news agency.
The federation said it had formed a new commission to pursue the enquiry. Two other coaches under investigation were also sacked but the federation said there was no proven link to Auras's case.

The federation launched its investigation last week into allegations by boxers that Auras had demanded money in exchange for places on the national team or for arranging lucrative international matches. Auras denied the accusations.
